messages:
Maya: Huge, huge thanks to Samir and Ash for saving the client demo yesterday — and for the surprise empanadas in the break room 🥟👏
Samir: Team effort! Jordan stayed back to reroute traffic while Ash hot-fixed the model config. couldn't have done it without you both :heart: 
Jordan: lol the empanadas were definitely the unsung heroes :raised_hands: Also, can we canonize a 'late-night demo snack rota'?
Ash: I'll second that. +1 to snacks. Also, quick note: the rollback was painless thanks to the canary fallback we had. ops-bot pinged at exactly the right moment.
deploy-bot: Deployment #447 auto-rolled back to v1.9.2 at 23:12 UTC after latency spike; alert suppressed per oncall policy.
Ben: This deserves a micro-celebration. Poll time: what's the official 'thanks' snack for oncall saves? Vote with emoji below!
Ben: 1️⃣ Boba (extra pearls)
Ben: 2️⃣ Mini churros (cinnamon dust forever)
Ben: 3️⃣ Savory kolaches (breakfast energy)
People Ops: Love it. I'll drop $50 snack credit into the team drawer and add a tiny note on your recognition folder. Also, Maya — I'll loop in the budget card for the ops socials. :moneybag:
Maya: Amazing, thanks People Ops! And big shout to Jordan for staying calm under pressure — sending you a little kudos badge on the recognition board. :star2:
Samir: Also, props to the infra tests we pushed last week. The extra assertion caught the failing edge case. :nerd_face:
Ash: Agreed. small infra test > big fire.
Jordan: Voting now: 2️⃣ churros for me. Anyone want to split the first round? I can grab a box tomorrow morning.
Maya: I'll chip in. If churros win, let's get an extra box for the dedicated snack champions (Samir & Ash). :cookie:
Ben: I'll tally reactions in an hour and post results. Thanks everyone — the quick responses yesterday really kept the demo intact. ❤️
People Ops: Tiny admin note — if you want the snack credited to your cards, DM me. Also added a 'kudos' tag to the demo incident so we can track appreciation trends.
Maya: Closing note: small moments like this make the grind worth it. Really appreciate y'all. :sun_with_face:
